description: Read the knocks your own door has taken, newest first, each with what the sender paid for it. Use this to triage: the amount is the sender's own statement of how much reaching you was worth. Also returns totals (waiting, all time, earned). Requires THREE_WS_API_KEY for the account that owns the door; it can never read anyone else's. Read-only.
name: knock_inbox
title: Read your knocks
